# Scan2CAD

> Professional-grade CAD and CNC conversion software that transforms raster images and PDFs into editable vector formats with advanced OCR and automation capabilities.

Scan2CAD is trusted by industry leaders including Intel, Honeywell, and NASA for converting scanned drawings and images into production-ready CAD files (DXF/DWG) and CNC machine code (G-code). The software features enhanced OCR technology, batch processing, and a Python API for enterprise automation.

## Key Topics

- CAD conversion
- CNC conversion
- OCR technology
- DXF/DWG export
- G-code generation
- Batch conversion
- Python API automation
- Raster-to-vector
- PDF conversion
- Enhanced OCR
- Image-to-CAD
- Software licensing
- Object recognition
- Security
- Free trial
